_about: How the stage layers were made (Hawkes Gen project imaginelivetv). Edit prompts are KEEP + text + TAIL, base image 1 = the plate. The pilot (plate, Dee/Okafor/trainee sheets) is in story/night-shift.md and night-shift/stage-marks.json. Re-make a layer: image.edit with that prompt and seed, image.segment with its prompt, node tools/pose-bake.mjs.
